name: CNN/DailyMail
description: A large-scale reading-comprehension and summarization dataset pairing news articles from CNN and the Daily Mail with cloze-style questions and human-written highlights.
citation: Hermann, K. M., Kocisky, T., Grefenstette, E., Espeholt, L., Kay, W., Suleyman, M., & Blunsom, P. (2015). Teaching Machines to Read and Comprehend. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 28, 1693–1701. https://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/2015/hash/afdec7005cc9f14302cd0474fd0f3c96-Abstract.html

license.notes: The upstream repository does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. The articles are copyrighted news content; review applicable rights and terms before use or redistribution.
